notes.title: Patch 0.5.2

[h3] Patch 0.5.2 finally adds the ability to sell various items to merchants and vendors for gold.
We have also improved the AI logic so the AI is now acting up properly and responds to every player action.

Players can also now find tutorials from the Options Menu, the game is also properly telling newcomers what to do via tutorial quests.

We have also finally enabled fall damage, so watch your steps since falling from non-lethal heights will brake bones as for falling higher... well everyone knows what will happen.

There is also more improvements, so remember to check out the summary below! [/h3]

notes.title: PF - Upcoming Changes
notes.notes:
We would like to give out a small update regarding what the development team has been doing that the players can expect to see in the next patch scheduled to go live within few weeks.

[b]What have we been up to?[/b]
[list]
[*] We have made a lot of changes to the current closed alpha build. The upcoming patch adds the ability to sell various items to merchants and vendors for gold.
[*] Enemy AI has seen improvements and bug fixes. No more enemies who will not attack the player if they get kited too far.
[*] Tutorials have been added to the options menu (esc button when in game) as well as to tutorial quests. Tutorial quests have also seen improvements during the last update.
[*] Death screen has been added, no more instant teleport to death realm
[*] Vendor item values and player item values have seen changes due to vendoring system
[*] Optimization improvements
[*] Fall damage and breaking bones if taking too much falling damage at once
[*] Itemization changes
[*] Small changes to some quests
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257016/6570acbce672c3b9c42eac76c89d4555d06cb82a.png[/img]

[b]What comes next?[/b]
There will always be optimization improvements to the game so we are always taking the priority in updating and optimizing the build to work in many different specs of machines. We will be working to add more QoL changes, improvements and more mechanics in the upcoming weeks!

notes.title: Patch 0.5.1.3
notes.notes:
[h3]Patch 0.5.1.3 changes the way how players gather ores and lumber. We thought that the old system where players go next to ores/trees and presses a key for automated gathering was boring and not enjoyable so now players can wield their axes and pickaxes and hit the nodes for faster and more enjoyable way to gather resources. Players can also use their own weapons for gathering, but this is significantly a lot slower way. 

We also made the game much more newcomer friendly. Now when players approach crafting tables or quest givers they will display their names above them for easier navigation, so no more need to hug the NPC:s to see who is who!

There is also more so remember to check out the changes summary below! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257016/55c5a5ea717b88c5276a01c76ea0ddfde0ef6bc8.png"][/img][/h3][p][u]Game Improvements and changes summary:[/u]

[b]World[/b]
[list]
[*] Crafting tables have their names displayed when approached
[*] Quest Givers have their names displayed when approached
[*] Outdoor PvP is enabled everywhere (for testing purposes)
[*] Slight visual changes for crafting tables
[*] Quest adjustments and changes, especially for tutorial quests
[*] Reputation item changes
[*] Added missing stats to some items
[/list]

[b]Player Changes and Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Gatherables (Ores and trees) no longer require the player to press key to gather, instead attacking them with proper tools give out ores and lumber
[*] Stat requirement updates
[*] Jewelcrafting item changes
[/list]

[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]

[*] Minor bugs fixed
[/list]

[h3]Mercenaries beware as the gates of Blackfang Keep have been opened...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257016/594ab9649386b4101ebf6bd6c38c46a77a515dbe.jpg[/img]

The latest patch introduces Blackfang Keep, an open world dungeon where players can team up and try to reveal the secrets of Count Blackfang. 
Blackfang Keep is our first farmable dungeon for new loot and activities to the players. Keep in mind during this patch only first wing is open and more wings will be opened with smaller patches.

Crafting got a slight change as we decided to divide each category of crafting so players now have access to Blacksmithing, Leatherworking and Tailoring. This decision should make crafting little bit more clearer. Also the UI of crafting and crafting icon sizes got a minor change.

We have also focused a lot on optimization and players should see big improvements on how the game runs. [/h3]

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.4.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Past Fate Patch 0.4.1 is now live[/h2]

[h3]The latest patch to Past Fate adds a bunch of new content to the game including nearly completed Edaria and start of Kingdom of Drosus. 
Kingdom of Drosus will be shaped a lot more during updates and it will eventually have one of the main capitals of Morsath Faction, Shadowpeak.

We have also made some UI changes mostly in preparation for character customization update that will eventually let players to customize their characters even more.
We also re-checked few of the older so called "group content" areas and found them to feel too crowded or lacking in resource so we have completely redone Blackfang Village and Bandit Hideout areas.

Also the world felt like it should have more resources so we ~tripled the amount of resources in the world and also added resources to the newer areas.

Also according to player feedback we have made it possible for players to use their character crafting outside of Crafting Tables. Player crafting only has limited items available for crafting so most of the demanding craftables still require Crafting Tables.

There is still more new things on this update so make sure to check out the changes summary below![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257016/54d2cc6f44b7809d99c92d3508587dd38b8a02d8.png[/img]

[u]Game Improvements and changes summary:[/u]

[b]World[/b]
[list]
[*] Edaria landscape completed and more content added for Weeping Hills and Southern Fields
[*] Kingdom of Drosus landscaped and content added, the area is still heavily WIP
[*] Animal NPC:s re-added and the AI of them has been improved
[*] More factional quests and NPC:s added
[*] Group Content areas (Blackfang Village and Bandit Hideout) have been remade to give better gameplay feeling for the players
[*] More new items added from NPC:s and from Quests
[/list]
[b]Player Changes and Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Player crafting added. Players are now able to craft some items without the use of Crafting Table's
[*] Optional Tutorial Quest giver added who teaches new players the basics via quests
[*] Hunting skill added, players are able to increase their hunting skill by hunting wildlife. This skill is still WIP and will be tweaked in upcoming updates
[*] UI improvements for character creation and skills
[*] Quest Giver markers updated to follow up players camera.
[*] Female Character's look improved slightly
[/list]
[b]Gathering and Crafting[/b]
[list]
[*] Resource amount tripled in old areas
[*] Changed the look of Ore and Tree resources 
[*] Added Pine Trees as collectible resource
[*] Some tweaks for amount received from gathering

[/list]
[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]
[list]

notes.title: Patch 0.4.0
notes.notes:
[h2]Past Fate Patch 0.4.0 is now live[/h2]

[h3]It has been almost a month since the Open Alpha concluded and we have been making some improvements behind the scenes while also reacting to player feedback to make sure Past Fate will be fun and enjoyable for our players. 

What does Patch 0.4.0 add to the game? 

Functional character saves, so players no longer need to start their characters from the beginning every time they relog.
We have also made sure that the game world looks much more breathing and realistic than it used to be by tweaking lightning, shadow and landscape settings.
There is a lot more content added and based on feedback we have improved the gameplay quite a bit, for example lowered some statistics, made combat little bit harder by making enemies last much more and more![/h3]

[*] Landscape improvements
[*] More content added to Kingdom of Edaria & Kingswall
[*] Kingswall has been rebuild and made to fit to the gameworld better
[*] Statistics have been tweaked based on player feedback
[*] Enemies have been tweaked based on player feedback
[*] Gathering has been tweaked based on player feedback
[*] Some crafting requirements have been lowered based on player feedback

notes.title: Patch 0.3.9
notes.notes:
[h1]Past Fate Patch 0.3.9 is now live[/h1]

[h3][b]Faction System Remade[/b]

Start as a Mercenary and increase your reputation among a chosen faction. Completing various tasks to one faction will lower the reputation of the other. This will allow the players to choose between factions, or stay completely neutral to both!

[b]Class System remade[/b]

Your class is based on your weapon and armor you choose to use. Weapons have their own special abilities and weapon arts. For example if you want to play as a tank, you should equip your character with a shield and heavy armor with defensive stat points. There are many combinations that you can create to play how you want to build your character.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257016/835f4226d8e6b878000f52a8113faf55865eca44.png[/img]

[u]Game Improvements and changes summary:[/u]

[list]
[*] Remaded Faction system.
[*] Remaded Class system.
[*] Swimming has been added to the game. Players are now able to swim and dive!
[*] All players start now with a Newharbor Teleport. This teleport allows players to teleport back to Newharbor if they get stuck for example.
[*] Major and minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.3.8
notes.notes:
[h1]Past Fate Patch 0.3.8 is now live[/h1]

[h3]Magic and witchcraft has found its place in the hands of the mercenary. Players are now able to wield Staves and Wands, casting elemental spells or if they come across with darker powers even raise the dead from their graves.

For players to unleash the powers within the magical weapons they need to craft runes. Rune Crafting is the newest crafting adaptation for Past Fate allowing players to craft different runes from Fire Runes to Death Runes. Rune Crafting is possibly to be changed later on.

Lets not forget that cooking was also added to Past Fate so every hungry traveler should visit the cooking fires and make some good potato stew, if they have gathered the ingredients of course! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257016/a02d28d806c8eee1bfa82be1afec70cb8314fe1a.png[/img]

[u]Game Improvements and changes summary:[/u]

[list]
[*] Magic weapons have been added with magic skills (Fireball, Summon Undead etc.)
[*] Runecrafting tables have been added. With Runecrafting tables players are able to make Runes needed for spells. Keep in mind Runecrafting is possibly to be changed in future patches based on feedback.
[*] Cooking Fires have been added. Cooking fire enables basic cooking
[*] Praying Altar has been added [EXPERIMENTAL]. Praying altar is where players can sacrifice goods for gods and receive blessings. Highly experimental
[*] Dual wielding weapons added
[*] Characters finally do save so players no longer need to start their adventures from the beginning each time they want to play
[*] Alchemy merchant added
[*] NPC character models changed
[*] Lore items added across the map 
[*] Bandit camps have been reworked in Westborough
[*] More optimization fixes
[*] More quests
[*] Major and minor bugs fixed
[*] Minor QoL changes (UI)
[/list]

notes.title: Past Fate Patch 0.3.5 is now live

[h3]Patch 0.3.5 makes improvements to combat and social aspect of the game. Enemy targeting now properly locks to target and you should no longer go past enemy when attacking.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.0
notes.notes:
Patch 0.3.0 brings out major changes to Past Fate. Shaping the world and story, modifying the starting area for Morsath faction and adding playable Valfalk faction to the game.

Westborough, the starting island for Morsath faction has been remade, and the size of Westborough has been increased by roughly 85 percent. A new area has been added to Westborough; the Swamp of the Forgotten. Will you reveal the mysteries this murky swamp has to offer?

Morsath players will help the village of Newharbor to hold the lines against the increasing undead threat, making Newharbor the last standing village against the cultists and undead. You, as a new recruit, must help the Newharborians, or every life on Westborough will fall to the undead.

Swamp of the Forgotten is a murky swamp area located in Westborough. It has been taken over by the fallen soldiers, who have risen from their slumber. The wildlife at the swamp is just as deadly as the undead, so the players must be careful of what might be stalking them.



Valfalk faction has been unlocked! Svigrun Ice Plains is the starting area for Valfalk players. After the creation of Valfalk, a union between the vikings of Hjyndall and the barbarians of Gulskir, the Grunash and Woldaudr clans rebelled against the idea of uniting with the barbarians, and merged together to create Draughjyll; a true viking clan under one banner.

Now the Draughjyll threatens to conquer all of Svigrun Ice Plains and making the Valfalk fight a battle in two fronts.

Valfalk players will start their journey at the village of Hjallrun. In here the players will help the villagers with the ever growing threat of the Draughjyll.
Death is not the end. 
Upon death players are sent to the underworld where they can do different optional activities from dungeons to even world bosses. Players can talk to the Valkyries in the Underworld to be sent back to the world of the living for a cost at any time. 
This cold and harsh realm is purely optional, and includes extremely challenging content, which is why it rewards players with unique cosmetic items.

Dying in the underworld will weaken your character significantly, until you are forced back to the world of the living once again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257016/e857cbcfd1500db2e37efc7ded63015148f9f84b.png[/img]

Game Improvements and changes summary:

- Westborough landscape size increased by 85% 

- Added Swamp of the Forgotten to Westborough

- Westborough has been remade. Some locations of towns have been changed and moved around

- Kingdom of Edaria has been redone for the following: Saint-Maurice has been renamed to Kingswall and has been remade. Noston has been remade from scratch, Blackfang Keep has been remade to look more sinister, Blackfang Keep area now has more undead villains and minions of Count Blackfang!

- Added Valfalk as playable faction

- Svigrun Ice Plains has been added. It works as the starting area for Valfalk faction

- Death realm has been added

- AI combat system has been remade from scratch. AI now properly reads players movement and acts without a pattern

- Player combat system has been remade from scratch. Players can now properly dodge to any direction and the style of combat changes depending of a weapon the player is using.

- Faction based PvP has been enabled

- New User Interface

- New music and ambience SFX

- Working mounts and riding system

- New enemies and world bosses

- Minor and major bug fixes
